direct_ridge.interpretation: central-tendency shrinkage lowers MAE but worsens squared/tail error; unsuitable as a universal Shapley cardinal replacement

survival_hazard.interpretation: near-equivalent to incumbent in several cells, especially QB, but paired gains are not durable/material enough to justify a separate route; QB H8 is materially worse

career_state_transition.interpretation: occasionally improves RMSE but has materially worse MAE/rank in many cells; retain as terminal/state diagnostic challenger rather than cardinal annual model

development_dynamic_route.interpretation: not promoted; holdout paired tests show lower MAE at Y6-Y8 but significantly worse mean squared error at Y4-Y8, exposing a tail-compression tradeoff rather than broad superiority

rationale.h3: production H3 remains unchanged; Y1-Y3 forecasts are inputs to these post-H3 challengers, so reusing them to claim H1-Y3 superiority would be leakage/non-comparable

post_selection_current_shadow_rule: new current-player shadows must use two_part_state for the primary Y4-Y8 cardinal curve; development-route/direct/hazard curves may be shown only as non-authoritative sensitivity diagnostics
